output: Pathological analysis confirms Stage IIIB Prostate cancer positive for somatic BRCA2 c.5946del (50% VAF) and PSA elevated expression. Identified genomic alterations establish actionable eligibility for targeted therapeutic selection.

instruction: Summarize the following oncology clinical report into two concise, voice-ready clinical sentences.
input: TREATMENT INITIATION NOTE [Patient SYNTH_PAT_04897, Encounter #3]: Clinical follow-up for Stage IIIB Prostate cancer positive for BRCA2 c.5946del. output: Patient with Stage IIIB Prostate cancer harboring BRCA2 c.5946del successfully commenced therapy with docetaxel at 160 mg orally once daily. Baseline hematologic indices were adequate and initial administration was tolerated without acute complications.
